workbench_not_found_desc: It may have been destroyed — the name is still available; the next acquire with this name gets a brand-new sandbox.
workbench_tree_loading_root: Reading directory (a sleeping sandbox wakes first)
workbench_tree_empty_dir: Empty directory — try uploading a file, or drop one into this area.
workbench_file_browser_desc: The sandbox is currently "{state}" — browsing files wakes it (frozen: ~50ms, stopped: a few seconds of cold start). Viewing this page alone does not.
workbench_tree_aria: File tree (drop files to upload into the focused directory)
workbench_focus_dir_title: Focused directory {dir} — uploads and new folders land here
workbench_select_a_file: Select a file on the left
workbench_select_a_file_desc: Preview and edit text here; images, PDFs and Office documents render too. The terminal is right below — edit, then run.
workbench_dirty_refresh_hint: Unsaved changes — save or discard first; reloading overwrites the draft
workbench_office_title: Office document — preview online with Microsoft
workbench_office_desc: Preview mints a signed link valid for {minutes} minutes and hands it to Microsoft's servers (view.officeapps.live.com) to fetch and render — the file's contents leave this machine. For sensitive content, download and open locally.
workbench_office_http_title: Office preview is unavailable over plain HTTP
workbench_office_http_desc: Minting a signed link needs the browser's crypto API (HTTPS only), and Microsoft's preview service can only fetch public HTTPS URLs — open the console via its bound HTTPS domain, or download and open locally.
workbench_too_large_title: File too large to preview online
workbench_binary_title: Binary file — cannot be shown as text
workbench_too_large_desc: {kind} online preview is capped at {cap} — download and open with a local tool.
workbench_binary_desc: The content contains NUL bytes — download and open with the right tool.
workbench_read_failed_title: Read failed — the file may have been deleted or renamed
workbench_offline_hint: No container to measure — observing never wakes
workbench_metrics_desc: Live values refresh every 5s; history is sampled by the daemon, ranges 1h / 24h / 7d.
workbench_processes_asleep: The sandbox is asleep; only its disk remains — processes return on the next wake.
workbench_processes_empty: No live processes — connect a terminal or run a background command via the SDK and it will show up.
workbench_activity_empty: No recent events for this sandbox — the activity ring keeps only the latest 1000 global events.
workbench_term_connecting: Connecting — a sleeping sandbox wakes first
workbench_terminal_hint: Opening wakes a sleeping sandbox; closing resumes the idle countdown
workbench_terminal_empty_desc: Connecting wakes a sleeping sandbox — viewing the workbench alone never thaws anything.
workbench_delete_desc: Gone means gone — there is no recycle bin in the sandbox.
workbench_delete_desc_dir: The whole directory and everything inside it will be deleted. Gone means gone — there is no recycle bin in the sandbox.
